subject.title: Cron Jobs Calendar View for Control UI

question: Should OpenClaw accept a refreshed 24-hour Cron Jobs timeline as the first Control UI calendar slice, require the broader daily/week/drag-and-drop design first, or defer this feature?
rationale: The request is a new user-facing Control UI product surface, and the linked implementation branch is stale, conflicting, and narrower than the full issue scope.

options.title: Request Fresh Timeline Slice
options.body: Ask for a fresh or heavily rebased PR against the current Cron page that implements the 24-hour timeline while preserving current list, filters, and run-history behavior.

options.title: Design Full Calendar Scope
options.body: Pause implementation until maintainers define the daily, weekly, stats, validation, and drag-and-drop editing behavior together.

options.title: Defer Core Calendar View
options.body: Leave the existing Cron list/run-history UI as the core surface for now and close or defer the linked implementation path after documenting the product decision.

recommendation.title: Request Fresh Timeline Slice
recommendation.body: Ask for a fresh or heavily rebased PR against the current Cron page that implements the 24-hour timeline while preserving current list, filters, and run-history behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current-main signal on the Cron page surface after the recent compact-row redesign.
